name: 52078-sharegpt-35ba3b-dflash-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash as the speculative drafter.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, single node. PP is not an alternative: it splits the model by layer and would change the per-stage layer composition, which is part of what this configuration is.
architecture: hybrid linear-attention + full-attention MoE (qwen3_5_moe): 40 text layers as 30 gated delta-net + 10 full attention, 256 experts top-8, ~36 B params BF16 (~72 GB of weights); the drafter is a separate 6-layer 385.9 M model (~0.8 GB), run at 8 draft tokens per step.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 200 warmup requests then 60 measured, 3600 s safety cap.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 60 single-turn prompts, every request forced to exactly 300 output tokens with EOS ignored and greedy decoding (temperature 0), request_format plain. Prompt tokens: total 16410, mean 273.5, p50 207, max 849. Materialised as configs/data/sharegpt-60-out300-qwen36.jsonl by configs/data/make-dataset.py.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on a 35B mixture-of-experts model with a draft model, streaming 300-token replies across two GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# `speculative-config` MUST STAY ON ONE LINE AS JSON: the config reader is a line reader, not a
# YAML parser -- it JSON-decodes a value beginning `{` and skips every indented line, so a block
# mapping here is dropped whole and the engine starts with no drafter at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"model": "z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash", "method": "dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 8}

max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
